intro: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P4 Pro is a premium RO water purifier featuring 100% RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) for Baby-Safe, purified drinking water. Its elegant design complements modern kitchens while the All Time Fresh in-tank UV purification ensures fresh water 24×7. With a Copper Fortified Mineralizer, 5-Star Water Saving Technology, digital display, and support for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources, the ProPlanet P4 delivers safe, healthy, and eco-friendly hydration.
